title: AFNI Zeropad

A.desc: adds 'n' planes of zero at the Anterior edge

AP.desc: specify that planes should be added or cut symmetrically to make the resulting volume haveN slices in the anterior-posterior direction

I.desc: adds 'n' planes of zero at the Inferior edge

IS.desc: specify that planes should be added or cut symmetrically to make the resulting volume haveN slices in the inferior-superior direction

L.desc: adds 'n' planes of zero at the Left edge

P.desc: adds 'n' planes of zero at the Posterior edge

R.desc: adds 'n' planes of zero at the Right edge

RL.desc: specify that planes should be added or cut symmetrically to make the resulting volume haveN slices in the right-left direction

S.desc: adds 'n' planes of zero at the Superior edge

master.desc: match the volume described in dataset 'mset', where mset must have the same orientation and grid spacing as dataset to be padded. the goal of -master is to make the output dataset from 3dZeropad match the spatial 'extents' of mset by adding or subtracting slices as needed. You can't use -I,-S,..., or -mm with -master

mm.desc: pad counts 'n' are in mm instead of slices, where each 'n' is an integer and at least 'n' mm of slices will be added/removed; e.g., n =  3 and slice thickness = 2.5 mm ==> 2 slices added

z.desc: adds 'n' planes of zero on EACH of the dataset z-axis (slice-direction) faces

description: Adds planes of zeros to a dataset (i.e., pads it out).
